MODE 4: SD (Single-Variable Statistics)

Enter one-variable data with DT (optional frequencies), then recall n, Σx, Σx², x̄, σx, or sx.

MODE 4 (SD) is one-variable statistics. An SD indicator appears. In this mode the M+ key becomes DT (register a sample) and SHIFT DT becomes CL (delete the displayed sample). After the list is entered, recall each result from its own page:

Results you can recall

  • Number of data points (n)Total number of observations. With FreqOn this is the sum of frequencies, not the number of distinct x-values.
  • Sum of values (Σx)Sum of the x-values. With FreqOn each class is weighted by its frequency.
  • Sum of squares (Σx²)Sum of the squared x-values. Needed to compute both standard deviations from S-SUM totals.
  • Arithmetic mean (x̄)Arithmetic mean of the current SD list: Σx divided by n.
  • Standard deviation (σx / sx)How spread out a list is. Population (σx) divides by n; sample (sx) divides by n − 1. Same list, two last steps.
note

Entering SD from another mode clears statistical memory. Pressing MODE 4 while you are already in SD does not clear it. For a new data set, use SHIFT 9 (CLR) → 1 (Stat) → EXE. Leaving SD/REG for COMP, CMPLX, BASE, or PRGM also clears STAT data.

Frequency setting (FreqOn / FreqOff)

Open SET UP with SHIFT MODE, then ◀ ◀ to the frequency screen. Factory default is FreqOn. FreqOff stores one list slot per observation; FreqOn lets you attach a count to each distinct x-value. SET UP pages use ◀ / ▶, not ▼.

keys
SHIFT→MODE→◀→◀→1 FreqOn / 2 FreqOff
  • FreqOn (default): x DT (frequency 1) or x ; f DT using SHIFT , (;) then the count f
  • FreqOff: x DT for every observation. Typing ; f DT gives Syntax ERROR
  • Maximum stored records: FreqOn 40, FreqOff 80. Extra input shows Data Full

Entering data (STAT-data editor)

steps

Basic workflow

  1. MODE→4 (to enter SD)
  2. If you were already in SD, SHIFT 9 (CLR) → 1 (Stat) → EXE
  3. Type a value and press DT. The Line = n counter increases
  4. Press DT again immediately to repeat the last x (same as entering it twice)
  5. Press AC when the list is complete, then open the statistic you need

FreqOn shortcut: if a class appears once, x DT is enough. If it appears f times, x ; f DT.

Example classes:

75 once → 75 DT
80 twice → 80 DT DT
85 four times → 85 ; 4 DT

View, edit, delete

  • View: cursor ▲ / ▼ through stored samples. A $ mark means more data below; ` means more above
  • FreqOn order is x1, Freq1, x2, Freq2, … FreqOff order is x1, x2, x3, …
  • Edit: display the sample, type the new number, EXE. Do not press DT or you will add a new point instead of replacing
  • Delete one sample: display it, then SHIFT DT (CL). With FreqOn, both that x and its frequency are removed
  • Undo last registration: SHIFT DT (CL) immediately after DT
  • Leave the list: AC, then recall S-SUM / S-VAR. Recalling stats while still browsing the list is a common source of wrong displays

Also in S-VAR (not split out)

After AC, minX and maxX are on the second S-VAR screen (both need at least one sample):

minX — SHIFT 2 → ▶ → 1 EXE
maxX — SHIFT 2 → ▶ → 2 EXE

Limits

  • Data Full at 40 records (FreqOn) or 80 (FreqOff): delete unused rows or collapse repeats with FreqOn
  • Independent memory M+ is the DT key in SD, so running totals with M+ are not available here
  • DT also overwrites Ans. Exit the list with AC before mixing ordinary arithmetic
  • SD has no quartile or median keys. MODE 1 when finished
